speaker: john_heminges
text: Fourteen shillings. Sit. I will say the figure once.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen. Write it received. I was not in the Knave. The book does not need me to have been.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Knave at two, and no part of yours against the title. The share is the share. It is not a wage for an afternoon you spent at the lodging.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I am not putting my stair into your fourteen. The stair had its own day. This cloth is the company's.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Fourteen, and the roads shut on Monday. I have not changed my mind. I am not asking you to vote it again.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The vote stands. Last day the twenty-sixth. I want the bills for the week in front of that, and I want them written where the house can earn them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday, Errors, and you play. Tuesday, rehearsal at nine, and Richard the Third at two, and you play. Wednesday, the old Hamlet, and you play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thursday, rehearsal at nine, and Errors again, and you play. Friday, Richard the Third at two. Not you. Saturday, the old Hamlet, and you play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Friday's Richard is on the bill, and your name is not in it. I will not pull you into a play the book has left you out of.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave me out of it. I am not playing Friday's king. I have not asked to.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The carrier on Thursday is not a bill we are setting. He was already on the book. Nobody is folding a letter over this cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing is being folded. Fourteen is received. I am not writing a total under it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No total. Last Saturday's ten stays last Saturday's. I am not adding a fortnight on the back of a share.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Then the house knows its week. Errors, the old Hamlet, and the king on the days John has said. My doors open for those.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I am still against the dark, and still inside the vote. Write me in the plays that have a part for me. Do not write me a new argument.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I have said the stair is not in this fourteen. I am going back down it. The cloth can survive me.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Fourteen, received, and a Friday he is not in. I can remember two facts if they stay two facts.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The heat can have the rest of the speech. I am not spending a share on it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Received. No total. The week is written. I am not taking the book home to improve it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday the fourteenth, Errors. Tuesday the fifteenth, the king, and you are in that one. Wednesday the sixteenth, the old play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thursday the seventeenth, Errors, and you are in it. Friday the eighteenth, the king, and you are not. Saturday the nineteenth, the old play, and you are in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In, and not in, as you have said. I will not correct Friday into a part.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Rehearsal Tuesday and Thursday at nine. Those are on the sheet. I heard them.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Nine is a morning. I can hate a morning without reopening a vote.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then we are done. Fourteen shillings, and the dates, and no sum underneath.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Done. The yard was hot enough without a second argument.
